get_codex_model_ids: get available Codex model IDs from API, local cache, config, and hardcoded defaults
fetch_models_from_api: fetch available Codex models from the OpenAI Codex API using an access token
add_forward_compat_models: add synthetic forward-compatible Codex model slugs when older template models are present
read_default_model: read the default Codex model from a config.toml file in the codex home directory
read_cache_models: read and deduplicate Codex model slugs from a local models_cache.json file
